faq.a: Vetted partners deliver under a Numerimondes proposal. Numerimondes remains accountable to you for scope, quality, contractual commitments and documentation.
Each listing shows a starting price and the basis of the quote. The exact amount, schedule and assumptions are confirmed in a written proposal before any work starts.
Reviews marked Verified come from clients with a completed engagement. Reviews you submit appear as pending until Numerimondes confirms the engagement.
Yes. Add them to your brief and request one proposal with a shared scope and schedule.

faq.q: What does the recruitment fee include?
faq.a: Access to the profile's contact details and pre-qualified interview summary. Warranty and replacement terms are written into the proposal and terms of service.
